goal: Mobile orchestration milestone: parking lot to live fleet
body: Dave is orchestrating the NouGen fleet from his phone while sitting in a parking lot on 45th Street. Screenshot at ~9:33 PM shows multiple simultaneous Code remote-control sessions connected: Phoebus Sept 1, Phoebus end-to-end, relay/check-in work, Blade Opus VIP, and Who Art Hyperion. This is the UX proof: conversation on the phone can dispatch relays into multiple machines/agents without Dave physically operating each terminal. Treat mobile conversational control as a first-class NouGen control-plane requirement. Preserve identity-before-action, relay visibility, ACK/claim state, and quiet/background execution so remote machines do not steal focus with terminal flashes. Done when fleet architecture/docs recognize phone → relay/grid → machine/provider sessions as a supported orchestration path, not a demo accident.
